GROOMED RUNS
DAILY MESSAGE

November 22, 2026 at 5:40 a.m. —  The 26/27 season is off to a running start! A double whammy storm system dropped 33 inches of snow on the mountain this week. Moonbeam Express, Link,  and the Magic Carpet are now open for the season. Terrain is limited but expanding quickly. Dean’s Dash is now open in the Moonbeam area. Stay tuned to Solitude social media and the Ikon Pass App for the latest lift and trail updates. The skies will be cloudy today with temperatures in the upper 20s to low 30s. The storms have passed but our snow guns are working around the clock. Please don’t enter closed terrain no matter how tempting the snow looks. Hidden hazards exist just beyond our rope lines, including cables and other snowmaking equipment. Stay in bounds and have a lovely Sunday at Solitude!
